map.常用合同模板要点参考，帮助您了解各类合同的关键条款: Common contract template checkpoints to help you understand the key clauses of each contract type
map.📖 查看「合同模板要点库 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Contract Template Checklist User Guide"
map.本工具仅供学习参考，不构成法律意见。正式合同请咨询专业律师，或使用正规合同文本。: This tool is for study and reference only and is not legal advice. For a formal contract, consult a licensed lawyer or use an official standard text.
map.双方姓名/名称、地址、联系方式、身份证号/统一社会信用代码: Names of both parties, addresses, contact details, ID numbers / unified social credit codes
map.明确约定交易的具体内容（货物、服务、工程等）: Specify exactly what is being traded (goods, services, works, etc.)
map.数量标准、质量要求、验收标准和方法: Quantity standard, quality requirements, acceptance criteria and method
map.总金额、支付方式、支付时间、发票要求: Total amount, payment method, payment schedule, invoice requirements
map.交货/完工/履行的时间节点和期限: Time points and deadlines for delivery / completion / performance
map.交货地点、服务提供地点、工程项目地点: Delivery place, place where services are provided, project site
map.违约情形、违约金计算、赔偿范围: Breach events, calculation of liquidated damages, scope of compensation
map.协商、调解、仲裁或诉讼，管辖法院/仲裁委: Negotiation, mediation, arbitration or litigation; the competent court / arbitration commission
map.不可抗力的定义、通知义务、责任免除: Definition of force majeure, duty to notify, exemption from liability
map.变更条件、解除情形、解除程序: Conditions for amendment, grounds for termination, termination procedure
map.保密范围、保密期限、泄密责任: Scope of confidentiality, duration, liability for disclosure
map.通知方式、联系方式变更、合同份数: Form of notices, changes to contact details, number of copies
map.个人查看身份证，企业查工商信息和资质: Check an individual's ID card; check a company's registration details and qualifications
map.所有重要约定必须写入合同，不要相信口头承诺: Every important term must be in the contract; do not rely on oral promises
map.涉及金额的条款，建议同时写阿拉伯数字和中文大写: For money clauses, give both Arabic numerals and the amount spelled out in words
map.合同空白处应划线或注明\"以下无正文\"，防止篡改: Strike through blanks or note "no text below" to prevent tampering
map.多页合同建议骑缝签字或盖章，每页都签更保险: For multi-page contracts use a signature or seal across the seam; signing every page is safer
map.自己必须保留一份签字盖章的合同原件: Keep one signed and sealed original for yourself
map.特别是小字、免责条款、违约责任部分: Especially the fine print, exclusion clauses and breach liability parts
map.重要合同找律师：: Use a lawyer for important contracts:
map.涉及大额、复杂交易，建议找律师审核: For large or complex transactions, have a lawyer review it
map.标的物、质量、价款、交付、验收: Subject matter, quality, price, delivery, acceptance
map.薪资、工时、社保、试用期、解除: Pay, working hours, social insurance, probation, termination
map.服务内容、标准、验收、报酬: Scope of services, standards, acceptance, remuneration
map.金额、利息、期限、还款方式、担保: Amount, interest, term, repayment method, security
map.工作内容、材料提供、验收、报酬: Scope of work, supply of materials, acceptance, remuneration
map.工程范围、工期、质量、价款、验收: Project scope, schedule, quality, price, acceptance
map.双方就主要条款达成初步意向，建议形成备忘录: The parties reach preliminary agreement on the main terms; a memorandum is recommended
map.一方或双方共同起草合同文本，明确所有约定: One or both parties draft the text, setting out every agreement
map.双方各自审核，提出修改意见，反复磋商: Each side reviews, proposes changes and negotiates back and forth
map.双方确认最终版本，确保内容准确无误: Both sides confirm the final version and check that the content is accurate
map.双方法定代表人或授权代表签字，加盖公章: Legal representatives or authorised representatives sign and the company seal is affixed
map.各方留存原件，重要合同建议公证或备案: Each party keeps an original; notarisation or filing is advised for important contracts
map.按合同约定履行，保留履行证据（送货单、对账单等）: Perform as agreed and keep evidence of performance (delivery notes, statements, etc.)
map.明确质量标准和验收流程，约定异议期，保留样品: Set quality standards and acceptance procedures, agree an objection period, and keep samples
map.明确付款时间和条件，最好分期付款，保留付款凭证: Set payment times and conditions, preferably by instalments, and keep payment records
map.明确工期计算方式、顺延情形、逾期违约金: Define how the schedule is calculated, permitted extensions and late-completion penalties
map.所有变更必须书面确认，口头变更事后容易扯皮: Every variation must be confirmed in writing; oral changes easily lead to disputes later
map.违约金约定要合理，过高或过低法院可能调整: Agree a reasonable penalty; a court may adjust it if it is too high or too low
map.明确约定管辖法院，最好约定在自己所在地: Specify the competent court, preferably in your own locality
map.⚠️ 以上内容仅供学习参考，不能替代专业法律意见。如有具体法律问题，请咨询执业律: ⚠️ The above is for study and reference only and is no substitute for professional legal advice. For a specific legal problem, consult a practising lawyer.
map.起草租房、劳动、借款、买卖等合同时，对照要点清单核对该写清的条款，避免遗漏。: When drafting a lease, employment, loan or sale contract, check the clause list to avoid omissions.
map.审查对方发来的合同，按要点逐项比对权责与风险点。: When reviewing a contract sent by the other side, compare rights, obligations and risk points item by item.
map.为不同业务类型快速调取对应条款模板，提高起草效率。: Pull up the matching clause templates for each business type to speed up drafting.
map.房屋租赁合同要点: Key points of a residential lease
map.应包含：月租金与支付方式（月付/季付/年付）、押金金额与退还条件、水电燃气物业费: It should cover: monthly rent and payment method (monthly / quarterly / yearly), the deposit and its refund conditions, who bears water, electricity, gas and property fees, repair responsibilities, early termination and breach liability.
map.借款合同要点: Key points of a loan contract
map.应写明出借人/借款人、借款金额（: State the lender / borrower, the loan amount (
map.）、用途、年利率（不得超过 LPR 四倍）、付息方式、逾期违约责任、管辖法院与实: ), the purpose, the annual rate (not above 4× LPR), how interest is paid, liability for late payment, the competent court and who bears the costs of enforcing the claim.
map.模板能直接当正式合同用吗？: Can a template be used directly as a formal contract?
map.模板仅供参考，正式签署前应结合具体交易、当地规定与对方资信补充修改，重大交易建议: Templates are reference only; adapt them to the transaction, local rules and the counterparty's standing before signing, and have a lawyer review major deals.
map.哪些条款最容易扯皮？: Which clauses cause the most disputes?
map.租金/价款支付节奏、押金退还、违约责任与解除条件、知识产权与保密、争议管辖，是最: Rent or price payment timing, deposit refunds, breach liability and termination conditions, IP and confidentiality, and dispute jurisdiction are the clauses most often contested, so spell them out.
